newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka lost opening gains and closed flat at 42.5250/5350 to the dollar after some private banks drew a modest amount of the U.S. currency from the interbank market, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted stronger at 42.5100/5300 per dollar in early trade but lost with some late-hour dollar purchase.

"Some private banks bought a modest amount against some LCs of consumer items. Big deals (in dollar) have been absent in recent weeks since there is virtually no import of capital machinery," said one dealer with foreign bank. The interbank call money rates ended at 7.0 to 7.5 percent, up from previous 6.5-7.0 percent.
